build_activation: build an activation layer from an Activation enum like ReLU, GeLU, or SquaredReLU
get_linear: build a linear layer with optional activation and dropout for a neural network
get_feedforward: build a feedforward network with configurable hidden dimension multiplier and activation
no_weight_decay: get a set of parameter names to exclude from weight decay in an optimizer
get_normalization_layer: build a normalization layer from a NormalizationType enum like LayerNorm or RMSNorm
